title: Schwan
subtitle: Packaging & CMF
overview: 为年轻消费群体设计的多功能面部棒包装，将可叠加妆效、随身携带与趣味交互整合为清晰而可延展的产品体验。
overviewEn: Multiple 4.5 g multi-use stick concepts for Schwan Match&Play Facestick, developed for younger consumers. My contribution focused on form and functional refinement using stock packaging, reducing tooling requirements and cost, and supporting multiple prototyping rounds through confirmation of the tooling solution.

sections.heading: 项目需求
sections.body: 面向 Gen Z 与 Alpha 用户，将遮瑕与护肤的双效定位转化为紧凑、圆润且便于随身携带的包装。设计重点包括旋转出料、帽盖集成涂抹器，以及可替换的挂环与趣味配件。
sections.bodyEn: For Gen Z and Gen Alpha users, the brief translated a dual concealing-and-skincare proposition into compact, rounded and portable stock packaging. Key directions included a twist-up mechanism, a cap-integrated applicator and interchangeable loops and accessories.

sections.heading: 双端与模块方向
sections.body: 围绕双端组合、可拆顶片和不同膏体模块展开多组结构，使功能扩展不牺牲随身尺寸与使用直觉。
sections.bodyEn: Concepts explored dual-ended combinations, removable top components and different formula modules, extending functionality without compromising portability or intuitive use.

sections.heading: 握持与随身交互
sections.body: 进一步探索软触按压、环形握持、挂绳连接与刷头配件，让产品同时具备携带性、趣味性和可识别的操作提示。
sections.bodyEn: Further exploration covered soft-touch pressing, ring grips, lanyard connections and brush accessories to improve portability, playfulness and clear interaction cues.

sections.heading: 比例推演
sections.body: 通过形体叠合与关键比例比较，校准顶部配件、主体截面和旋转底座的视觉关系，为最终方案收敛建立统一尺度。
sections.bodyEn: Overlay studies and key proportion comparisons calibrated the relationship between the top accessory, body profile and twist-up base, refining the selected direction around existing packaging constraints.

sections.heading: 最终效果
sections.body: 在容量、比例、配件组合与使用直觉之间建立平衡，以轻盈、圆润的产品语言完成最终方案表达；经过多轮打样后，开模方案已确认。
sections.bodyEn: The confirmed direction balances capacity, proportions, accessories and intuitive use in a light, rounded product language. Following multiple prototyping rounds, the tooling solution was confirmed.
